parameters.description_en:
The ARN of the CMK for which you want to set deletion protection.  
You can call the [DescribeKey](~~28952~~) operation to query the CMK ARN (Arn).
parameters.description_zh:
待设置删除保护的CMK ARN。  
您可以调用[DescribeKey](~~28952~~)接口查看CMK ARN（Arn）。
parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the CMK for which you want to set deletion protection.

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection. Valid values:

- true: enables deletion protection.

- false (default): disables deletion protection.

是否开启删除保护，取值：

- true：开启删除保护。

- false（默认值）：关闭删除保护。
